one_liner: Financial data network API for linking bank accounts and pulling transactions, balances, identity and auth data.
notes: Auth: static client_id + secret copied from the Dashboard, sent in the body or PLAID-CLIENT-ID/PLAID-SECRET headers (not signed/HMAC) -> api_key. Plaid Link's public_token/access_token is a per-Item end-user token obtained with those keys, not a separate developer auth method; Plaid's OAuth docs are about bank (institution) OAuth inside Link, not OAuth into Plaid's API. Access: Sandbox is free and self-serve, but real data needs an application for Production (Trial plan application, then full Production with company info and a security questionnaire that Plaid reviews); Limited Production was replaced by Trial plans for teams created on/after 2026-04-15. Hence approval_required + ready_with_review. main_blocker app_review chosen over partner_program because it is a production-access/compliance review, not a partnership. API is JSON-over-HTTP POST (RPC-ish) with no GraphQL -> rest. Official MCP: Plaid-hosted Dashboard MCP server (Production-approved teams only) plus a local MCP server in Plaid's AI coding toolkit.

evidence.quote: Almost all Plaid API endpoints require a client_id and secret.
The Plaid API is JSON over HTTP.
The Plaid Sandbox is a free and fully-featured environment for application development and testing.
To view pricing, apply for Production access.
The Dashboard MCP server is a remote MCP server hosted by Plaid.
Your team must be approved for Production access with at least one Plaid product to use the MCP server.
You must complete a questionnaire about your company's risk and security practices before accessing certain bank APIs.
